verdict.rationale: The evidence shows rule actions, AI Studio 'no-code automations', webhooks, an API, and third-party automation tools such as Zapier, n8n, and Pipedream. None of it documents a time-based or recurring schedule (cron, recurring tasks, or scheduled rules). Event-triggered rules and one-off automations are adjacent features, and external schedulers are user-side workarounds, so neither counts as recurring scheduling for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
